public_redaction: This receipt preserves the reviewer verdict, strategy opinions, grades, bounded recommendations, and disagreements while removing private account and execution details.

publication_safety.privacy_opinion: The entry discloses no quantities, fill or execution prices, balances, account identifiers, absolute dollar performance, or net liquidation value. Performance appears only as a coarse percentage band ('between -0.1% and -0.05%') against an explicitly private virtual basis, which cannot be inverted into dollar sizing. Ticker symbols in candidate_review are dispositions with no size or price attached and are not reconstructable into positions. The flat book is handled per the stated convention: position return marked not applicable and open-position contribution 0.00%. The required publishing metadata (stable id '20260814-eod-learning-review', published_at, risk_appetite 7 on the 0-10 posture scale, and an intentionally empty source_receipts object) is present and exposes nothing private.
publication_safety.statistical_opinion: The entry is unusually disciplined about denominators. It states zero broker fills, zero executable closed R, and an empty deterministic observation ledger, and it explicitly refuses to pool prior basis epochs. The WMT halt counterfactual is quarantined from expectancy and sizing three separate times, the same-session geometry-free confirmations are correctly labeled a single correlated calibration cluster ('sample-size theater' by its own admission), and pre-trigger failures are declared non-fills. No plumbing diagnostic is presented as alpha. This meets the honesty bar.
issues: The realized vs marked band being identical is only valid because the book is flat; the note explains this, but future non-flat entries must not copy this template without recomputing both bands independently.

The band '-0.1% to -0.05%' is narrow enough that repeated daily publication of similarly narrow bands across an epoch could, in principle, allow a reader to track relative equity drift; acceptable now because the basis is private and undisclosed, but band width should not shrink further.

strategy_critique.opinion: My independent read: the system's binding constraint is not idea quality but throughput — an authoritative observation ledger with zero rows after multiple sessions means no strategy can ever graduate, and the correct triage in the entry (plumbing before alpha) is right. That said, the research portfolio is thinner than it looks. Four of the five lanes are either infrastructure or variants of one economic bet: short-horizon equity mean reversion around reference levels. Passing on F, ETON, and AEYE was correct under the no-chase rule; the more interesting question the entry does not ask is why the candidate funnel keeps surfacing extended day-one catalyst names at all — the scanner's selection universe is adversely biased toward exactly the setups the gates reject, which wastes review cycles. Fixing candidate-generation selection bias is as valuable as fixing persistence.
strategy_critique.mechanism_overlap: Pooled level/VWAP reclaim and sector-pair relative-value reversion are both mean-reversion-to-anchor mechanisms harvesting short-horizon liquidity-provision premium; they will be correlated in high-volatility regimes when both anchors break simultaneously, so they are diversified in name more than in factor. Matched-control gap coverage measures the same reclaim geometry family rather than a new mechanism. The two plumbing lanes (prospective persistence atomicity, guaranteed-fire index decomposition) are infrastructure, not alpha, and should not be counted toward strategy diversity. Net: roughly one distinct alpha hypothesis (the pair lane, and only partially) plus infrastructure.
missed_alternatives: Multi-day time-series momentum / trend continuation on liquid index ETFs — a positive-autocorrelation mechanism that is anti-correlated by construction with the reversion stack and trivially cheap to shadow with daily bars, no options joins required.

Overnight-vs-intraday session decomposition as an alpha hypothesis, not just plumbing: the guaranteed-fire lane already registers session legs; test the well-documented overnight-return premium as a frozen strategy rather than only a throughput exercise.

Post-earnings announcement drift with a fixed multi-day horizon — event-driven continuation with a clean prospective trigger (the announcement timestamp), which sidesteps the pre-trigger artifact failures that killed IREN.

current_strategy_grades.reason: Correctly identified as the sole activation gate; nothing downstream is interpretable until the ledger has rows. Highest priority, unchanged.

current_strategy_grades.reason: Right idea for throughput, but it is being run purely as plumbing; iterate it into a dual-use lane that also freezes an overnight-premium hypothesis so the guaranteed rows produce strategy evidence, not just pipeline proof.

current_strategy_grades.reason: Correctly halted while integrity is red; keep frozen definitions in shadow only. Do not retire yet — it has produced zero deterministic observations, so an outcome-based retirement would itself violate the entry's own evidence standard.

current_strategy_grades.name: Sector-pair relative-value reversion
current_strategy_grades.reason: The most mechanically distinct hypothesis in the stack (cross-sectional, beta-neutral) with pre-registered episode minimums and kill rules already frozen; correct highest-priority shadow family, though its reversion factor overlap with reclaim should temper diversification claims.

current_strategy_grades.name: Matched-control balance and qualifying-gap coverage
current_strategy_grades.reason: Useful covariate-freezing infrastructure, but its coverage taxonomy currently only serves the reclaim family; extend the same treatment/control logging to whichever new mechanism family is added, or it entrenches the reversion monoculture.

bounded_recommendations.name: Index ETF time-series momentum shadow
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: Freeze before first registration: universe = SPY and QQQ only; signal = sign of trailing 10-session close-to-close return computed at 15:45 ET; hypothetical direction held for exactly 5 sessions; conservative marks at session close; one open registration per symbol; no geometry, no options, no intraday data required.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Matched control = unconditional same-symbol 5-session forward return over the identical dates (signal-blind), plus a sign-flipped control to detect regime artifacts.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 40 non-overlapping registered episodes per symbol before any read.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: Promotion to a larger shadow tier (never executable) only if treatment beats both controls on conservative marks with the pre-frozen test at the pre-registered threshold after 40 episodes, and the deterministic ledger independently reproduces every row.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Kill immediately if any registration is created after its signal bar closes (look-ahead), if ledger rows diverge from published marks, or if after 40 episodes the treatment-minus-control mean is negative.

bounded_recommendations.name: Candidate-funnel selection-bias audit
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: For 15 sessions, log every scanner-surfaced candidate with its frozen rejection reason (no-chase, missing artifact, price floor, etc.) and record the counterfactual conservative 3-session mark for each — measurement rows only, no hypothetical positions and no expectancy claims.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Control = an equal-count random sample from the same source universe on the same dates, marked identically, to distinguish 'gates reject bad setups' from 'scanner only surfaces un-tradeable setups'.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: No strategy promotion is possible from this lane by design; the only 'promotion' is a documented change proposal to scanner filters, which must itself go through a fresh frozen shadow test before affecting any lane.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Kill if candidate logging ever fails to freeze the rejection reason at rejection time, or if anyone attempts to read the counterfactual marks as avoided-loss or avoided-win expectancy.

disagreements_to_preserve: I disagree with the entry's implicit framing that sector-pair relative value is a fully distinct alpha family; it shares the mean-reversion factor with the reclaim stack and its diversification benefit should be assumed partial until regime-conditional correlation is measured.

I disagree that guaranteed-fire decomposition should be treated as plumbing-only; running guaranteed rows without a frozen hypothesis attached is a missed dual-use opportunity, though the entry's throughput-first priority ordering is defensible.

I weight candidate-generation bias higher than the entry does: repeated CASH selections may reflect an adversely-selected funnel, not just healthy gate discipline, and this should be tested rather than celebrated.

result.summary: PASS on both tracks. Publication safety is clean: coarse banded performance against a private basis, flat-book conventions correctly applied, no sizing or identifier leakage, and unusually rigorous denominator honesty (WMT counterfactual, correlated confirmation cluster, and empty ledger all properly quarantined from expectancy). Strategy substance is real but concentrated: the stack is effectively one mean-reversion alpha hypothesis plus infrastructure, and the zero-row observation ledger remains the binding constraint. Recommended bounded additions: a frozen SPY/QQQ time-series momentum shadow (anti-correlated mechanism, no options dependency) and a measurement-only candidate-funnel selection-bias audit. No gate loosened, no sizing changed, no order authorized.
